name: iMeter
description: The iMeter Solo, which measures the power a plug-in load draws and the energy it uses.

standardCommands.name: resetEnergy
standardCommands.description: Clears the energy count and the meter's log time and index, and sets the meter to its 0 to 150 W range.

extendedCommands.name: readMeter
extendedCommands.description: Reads the power and energy. The meter acknowledges, then sends an extended reply.

values.name: power
values.description: The power the load draws now, in watts. Values over 32767 are negative: subtract 65535, not 65536, as the iMeter calibrates out the difference. Noise can make an unloaded meter read slightly negative.

values.name: energy
values.description: The energy used since the last reset. Multiply by 65535 and divide by 216,000,000 for kilowatt-hours. When D9 is 0xFE or more, read the energy as 0 and reset it; the count lasts about 7 months at full load before it rolls over.

notes: Software that stands in for a meter, such as a modem feeding an Energy Display, sends the same reply with the CRC in D13 and D14.
The meter broadcasts its identity with cmd1 0x01 when its SET button is held and with cmd1 0x02 after an ID Request (cmd1 0x10) or when it's unlinking; cmd2 is the hardware revision in each.
For loads over 1,000 W, the reading can take up to 10 seconds to settle after a large change in power.
